description: The last JGSDF Bartol built and the last flown; final flight 25 Mar 2002 from Takayubaru via Akeno and Kisarazu to Kasumigaura; moved here late July 2004; carries the markings and callsigns of all six JGSDF V-107 units plus SAYONARA VICTOR LAST FLIGHT 25 MAR 2002 behind the right door and LAST VICTOR AVN KINGFISHERS on the rear engine housing
